item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Kabir's electric cell joined to a small lamp. End X is the raised metal cap. End Y is the flat metal disc. The lamp lights.

Which claim about the cell is correct?

options.A: X is the positive terminal and Y is the negative terminal; a closed path through the lamp lets the cell supply energy.
options.B: X is the negative terminal and Y is the positive terminal; the raised cap is always negative.
options.C: Both X and Y are positive terminals, so the lamp can glow without a return path.
options.D: The cell can run the lamp even if the wire at Y is left disconnected.
